mentions.name: ffmpeg-based video utility app
mentions.description: A small video utility app built on top of ffmpeg that converts videos between formats, splits videos into clips, combines multiple videos into a single one, and takes screenshots.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a small video utility app, built on top of ffmpeg. It allows you to convert from/to different formats, split a video into clips, combine videos into a single one, take screenshots…
